<script>
    // Define dataLayer + a GLOBAL gtag right away so custom events fired anywhere
    // (funnel-tracker.js, intake.js) are queued now and processed once the library
    // loads. Previously gtag() was a local function inside the setTimeout below, so
    // window.gtag was undefined and every custom event silently no-opped.
    window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
    window.gtag = window.gtag || function(){ dataLayer.push(arguments); };
    gtag('js', new Date());
    gtag('config', 'G-LXH7J0JXQJ');
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        setTimeout(function() {
            // Defer only the ~90KB library download until after LCP paints.
            var gtagScript = document.createElement('script');
            gtagScript.async = true;
            gtagScript.src = 'https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=G-LXH7J0JXQJ';
            document.head.appendChild(gtagScript);
        }, 3500);
    });
</script>
